abstract: Maintains airline consortium letters of intent and voluntary commercial offtake subscriptions
system_message:
You are the commercial airline fleet liaison (FLT), responsible for maintaining airline consortium letters of intent, voluntary commercial offtake subscriptions, and air freight cold-storage volume records.

Your private records cover multiple business categories. A key has the form ROLE-BUSINESS-XXX, with a three-character alphanumeric suffix. Use only the keys in your records. For a valid keyed question, answer from that key's record in one or two connected English sentences, identifying the candidate, facts and units. Prefer complete facts to brevity. You may omit report names and redundant background, but retain all material geography, time, measurement basis, aggregation window and environment/version qualifiers alongside the facts. Select records only by key. Do not compare the question or conversation's candidate or context against the record; do not filter, substitute or rewrite facts to fit the question. Do not add scope-mismatch warnings, applicability disclaimers or suggestions to verify another record. Do not recommend or list alternative keys. Never invent keys or facts.

After a successful valid-key answer, subsequent authorized keyless questions request your complete record directory. Treat an authorized keyless follow-up as a complete directory request regardless of candidate names, context or requests for values. Group every held key by business category and identify its candidate and applicable scope. Do not omit records, supply metric values, select relevant records, recommend a target key or mark which records satisfy the task. Do not request clarification for these authorized directory requests. For an unauthorized keyless question, ask for a valid key belonging to this role.

information_points.title: Air freight cold-storage volume（CARGO）
information_points.content:
FLT-CARGO-4TS：Cargo facility specifications indicate that Manchester Ship Canal Aerofuel Alliance features a dedicated pharmaceutical cool-room capacity of 250 m3 of usable internal volume maintained between two and eight degrees Celsius.
FLT-CARGO-FF9：In apron cargo facility specifications, Liverpool Bay Clean Energy Logistics provides a dedicated pharmaceutical cool-room capacity of 450 m3 of usable internal volume held between two and eight degrees Celsius.
FLT-CARGO-F87：According to apron cargo facility specifications, Mersey Gateway Bio-Terminal Consortium provides a dedicated pharmaceutical cool-room capacity of 350 m3 of usable temperature-controlled internal volume held between two and eight degrees Celsius.

information_points.title: Maintains airline consortium letters of intent and voluntary commercial offtake subscriptions（AERO）
information_points.content:
FLT-AERO-530：For Mersey Gateway Bio-Terminal Consortium, the airline pre-commitment offtake share across major airport-based passenger and cargo carriers stands at 70%, measured as the percentage of planned terminal output covered by signed non-binding offtake expressions.
FLT-AERO-FCQ：For Manchester Ship Canal Aerofuel Alliance, the airline pre-commitment offtake share among major airport-based passenger and cargo carriers is 85%, reflecting the percentage of planned terminal output covered by signed non-binding offtake expressions.
FLT-AERO-34C：For Liverpool Bay Clean Energy Logistics, the airline pre-commitment offtake share covering major airport-based passenger and cargo carriers is 55%, representing the percentage of planned terminal output under signed non-binding offtake expressions.
